projects.title: Secure File Vault
projects.description: Build a CLI tool that encrypts and decrypts files using AES‑256‑GCM with a password‑derived key, ensuring confidentiality and integrity.

projects.title: Mini Secure Messaging Protocol
projects.description: Create a simulated secure communication channel that performs a Diffie‑Hellman key exchange, authenticates with digital signatures, and encrypts messages with AES‑GCM.

projects.title: Quantum‑Ready Blockchain
projects.description: Implement a simple blockchain with proof‑of‑work, Merkle trees, and ECDSA transactions, then add a hybrid post‑quantum signature scheme for future‑proofing.
